scientific_integrity: The finite-field local linear systems and the large-dimension concentration estimates are proved algebraically; finite computations provide independent reproducible checks only. The published idempotent-fiber structure and antichain closure theorem are credited to their authors.
scientific_limitations: Full incidence algebras of complete height-two bipartite posets only; not arbitrary posets or smaller antichain monoids.
Balanced limits require equal part sizes and fixed finite field order.
Enumeration concerns labeled ordered pairs of idempotents, not equivalence classes.
A mathematical priority search cannot establish exhaustive novelty; independent validation remains unperformed.
title: A three-quarter product-idempotence law for finite bipartite incidence monoids
